mapper.select: SELECT id, part_id, chapter_order, title, description, created_time, updated_time FROM NC.study_chapter WHERE part_id = #{partId} ORDER BY chapter_order, id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NC.study_chapter WHERE part_id = #{partId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NC.study_chapter (part_id, chapter_order, title, description) VALUES (#{partId}, #{chapterOrder}, #{title}, #{description})
